compiled_state.title: As a copy-story closer, I have a deterministic post-processor that populates checks and enforces sc-7 thresholds
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Implement a deterministic post-processing pipeline that computes per-item fk_grade (Flesch-Kincaid), banned_words_found, and active_voice for a gov-copy artifact, evaluates sc-7 closing thresholds, and flags deviations.
**Why**: sc-4 mandates these fields come from deterministic post-processing rather than LLM self-attestation; sc-7 requires per-item threshold enforcement with documented reasons.
**Scope**:
- IN: script that computes fk_grade / banned_words_found / active_voice for every item; threshold evaluation (fk_grade ≤ 8, banned_words_found empty, active_voice true); deviation flagging in rationale.deviations; ≥95% closing condition; banned-word list and fk_grade threshold loaded from documented config
- OUT: gov-copy-writer agent that emits the draft artifact (separate story); coordination-pass logic (separate story)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, running the post-processor on a gov-copy-writer draft artifact populates checks.fk_grade, checks.banned_words_found, and checks.active_voice for every item
  ← Satisfies: sc-4
- When this story is complete, the script overwrites any LLM-supplied check values and records the source of each check as deterministic-post-processing
  ← Satisfies: sc-4
- When this story is complete, items failing fk_grade ≤ 8, banned_words_found empty, or active_voice = true thresholds appear in rationale.deviations with a populated reason field
  ← Satisfies: sc-7
- When this story is complete, the script emits a summary line indicating whether the ≥ 95% closing threshold is met and exits non-zero when not met
  ← Satisfies: sc-7
- When this story is complete, the banned-word list and fk_grade threshold are loaded from a documented config location rather than hardcoded
  ← Satisfies: sc-7
- When this story is complete, post-processing overwrites checks{} values and (re)adds deviation entries for items that fail thresholds, but preserves any pre-existing rationale.deviations[].reason text supplied by gov-copy-writer for the same rule_id; when a failing item has no author-supplied reason, post-processing inserts the placeholder reason "unjustified" so the deviation is detectable
  ← Satisfies: sc-7
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations
- [Determinism] Use an established readability library for fk_grade and a rule-based active-voice heuristic with documented limitations.
- [Configurability] Agencies may extend banned-word lists; surface this in dso-config or a sibling location.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
